review.abstention_reason: All supplied hunks are from GitHub Actions workflow configuration files. No PostHog application, database, or backend code is supplied. No tier can be assigned.
review.posthog_relevance: Changes are restricted to workflow execution and release tagging, not application functionality.
review.reason: The provided observations consist entirely of GitHub Actions workflow configuration changes. While these changes restrict execution and notifications to the PostHog repository, they do not modify the PostHog application, database, or backend logic. Therefore, no tier can be assigned based on application-level contribution or reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The lack of application, database, or backend code prevents establishing a tier. Workflow changes alone do not demonstrate substantive, bounded capability or systemic risk reduction within the PostHog product itself.
